articles.title: Efficient Transformer Inference on Edge Devices: A Systematic Evaluation
articles.abstract: Deploying transformer models on resource-constrained edge devices remains challenging. We present a systematic evaluation of quantization and pruning strategies across 12 architectures. Our benchmark suite covers GLUE and SQuAD, with all code available at https://github.com/example/edge-transformers. Experiments on 10,000 samples show up to 3.2x speedup with under 1% accuracy loss. We acknowledge that our evaluation is limited to encoder-only models.

articles.title: A Survey of Graph Neural Network Acceleration Techniques
articles.abstract: Graph neural networks have become central to relational learning. This survey reviews acceleration techniques spanning sampling, quantization, and hardware co-design, categorizing 85 papers published between 2019 and 2024.
